NINJA_SLAYER_CHADO_BREATHING.title: Chado Breathing
NINJA_SLAYER_CHADO_BREATHING.description: Increase the Energy provided by each [gold]Chado[/gold] in your hand by the given amount. If you have none, spend 1 Chado Breathing to create a Chado, then increase its Energy by the remaining amount.
NINJA_SLAYER_POSITIVE_EFFECTS.title: Buffs
NINJA_SLAYER_POSITIVE_EFFECTS.descriptio:
The following effects count while positive, once per type.
[gold]Strength[/gold], [gold]Dexterity[/gold], [gold]Vigor[/gold], [gold]Karate[/gold]
[gold]Focus[/gold], [gold]Artifact[/gold], [gold]Buffer[/gold], [gold]Intangible[/gold]
[gold]Thorns[/gold], [gold]Plating[/gold], [gold]Regen[/gold], [gold]Evasion[/gold]
[gold]Naraku Life[/gold], [gold]Stretch[/gold], [gold]Soar[/gold], [gold]Aim[/gold]
